# Verywell Health

> > Evidence-based health information covering medical conditions, treatments, nutrition, and preventive care with expert medical review.

Verywell Health provides comprehensive, medically-reviewed health content for patients and caregivers. The site covers disease management, symptom guides, medication information, nutrition advice, and preventive healthcare strategies across all body systems and life stages.

## Key Topics

- Inflammation and anti-inflammatory treatments
- Blood sugar management and diabetes (A1C, Metformin, Ozempic)
- Hormone health (Cortisol, DHEA, Vitamin D)
- Joint pain and arthritis conditions
- Autoimmune diseases (ANA testing, Sjogren's)
- Neurological conditions and brain health
- Medication guides (Methotrexate, Amitriptyline)
- Digestive health and symptom relief
- Sexual health and men's health
- Nutrition and healthy eating
- Preventive care and vaccines
- Symptom management strategies
- Medical imaging (CT scans)
- Caregiver support and communication

## Core Navigation

- [Verywell Health - Know More. Feel Better.](https://verywellhealth.com): Homepage: reliable health information and expert medical advice
- [All Health - Symptoms, Diagnosis, & Treatment](https://verywellhealth.com/health-a-z-4014770): A-Z directory of health conditions with symptoms and treatments
- [Prevention and Treatment - Vaccines, Aging, and More](https://verywellhealth.com/prevention-and-treatment-4158390): Preventive health hub: vaccines, nutrition, supplements, healthy aging

- [Alcoholic Liver Disease: Reversibility, Signs, Stages](https://verywellhealth.com/alcoholic-liver-disease-8414014): Alcoholic liver disease stages, symptoms, and reversibility guide
- [Cerebral Palsy: Coping, Support, and Living Well](https://verywellhealth.com/cerebral-palsy-coping-support-and-living-well-4160517): Cerebral palsy coping strategies and support resources for living well
- [Fungating Breast Cancer: Wound Care, Relief, and Coping](https://verywellhealth.com/fungating-breast-cancer-wound-care-relief-and-coping-6744511): Advanced breast cancer wound care and symptom management guide
